title: sedum annuum subsp. litoreum
intro: Sedum annuum subsp. litoreum, commonly known as seaside sedum, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Sedum annuum subsp. litoreum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its analgesic, anti-edematous, and immunomodulatory effects.
